changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "user".api_key ( id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4() NOT NULL, owner_in TEXT NOT NULL, -- egasining PINFL/STIR (barqaror kalit) owner_user_id UUID, -- yaratilgan paytdagi user id (ma'lumot uchun) name TEXT NOT NULL, -- kalit nomi ("1C integratsiyasi") key_prefix TEXT NOT NULL, -- ko'rsatish uchun boshlanishi key_hash TEXT NOT NULL, -- SHA-256 hex scopes TEXT[] NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', -- ApiScope all_templates BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT false, -- true -> full template_ids UUID[], -- all_templates=false bo'lganda expires_at TIMESTAMP, -- NULL -> abadiy webhook_url TEXT, webhook_secret TEXT, webhook_events TEXT[], -- bo'sh/NULL -> barcha hodisalar active BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT true, revoked_at TIMESTAMP, last_used_at TIMESTAMP, deleted BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT false, created_date TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, last_modified_date TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ); CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS uq_api_key_hash ON "user".api_key (key_hash); CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_api_key_owner_in ON "user".api_key (owner_in);
